name: Pumps · fixed half
scope: One complete 350 mm board-to-male-pogo harness, finished with front-top loose on the bench
mapStatus: Circuit and solder-tail order follow the assembly schedule. The white-striped edge is assigned to AM2 as a bench convention; it is not a record of an assembled sample.
overview: Four separate motor conductors run from the J13 JST plug to four solder tails on the fixed male pogo half. Each solder joint has its own heat-shrink sleeve.

ribbons.description: A1 is the white-striped edge and lands on AM2. Count away from it: A2 AM1, A3 BM2, A4 BM1. Split the pogo end back 20 mm.

pins.destination: Male pogo tail 1 · machine +X end · pump A
pins.detail: Striped A1 joins J13 cavity 1 / AM2 to the male pogo tail at machine X +3.81 mm. This is one H-bridge motor lead, not a shared supply.

pins.destination: Male pogo tail 2 · machine X +1.27 mm · pump A
pins.detail: A2 joins J13 cavity 2 / AM1 to the male pogo tail at machine X +1.27 mm. Keep it separate from AM2 and both pump-B conductors.

pins.destination: Male pogo tail 3 · machine X −1.27 mm · pump B
pins.detail: A3 joins J13 cavity 3 / BM2 to the male pogo tail at machine X −1.27 mm. It carries one pump-B motor lead directly through the pogo contact.

pins.destination: Male pogo tail 4 · marked machine −X end · pump B
pins.detail: A4 joins J13 cavity 4 / BM1 to the male pogo tail at machine X −3.81 mm. The marked end of the magnetically aligned half stands at machine −X.

conductors.title: J13 AM2 → male pogo tail 1
conductors.to: Male pogo tail 1 · +X end · pump A
conductors.toPart: Soldered male pogo tail · individual heat-shrink
conductors.note: White-striped A1. Tail order is read in machine X: this is the +3.81 mm station. Slip the sleeve on before soldering; cover this joint alone.

conductors.title: J13 AM1 → male pogo tail 2
conductors.to: Male pogo tail 2 · X +1.27 mm · pump A
conductors.toPart: Soldered male pogo tail · individual heat-shrink
conductors.note: Second conductor counted from the white stripe. Tail order is read in machine X. Slip the sleeve on before soldering; cover this joint alone.

conductors.title: J13 BM2 → male pogo tail 3
conductors.to: Male pogo tail 3 · X −1.27 mm · pump B
conductors.toPart: Soldered male pogo tail · individual heat-shrink
conductors.note: Third conductor counted from the white stripe. Tail order is read in machine X. Slip the sleeve on before soldering; cover this joint alone.

conductors.title: J13 BM1 → male pogo tail 4
conductors.to: Male pogo tail 4 · marked −X end · pump B
conductors.toPart: Soldered male pogo tail · individual heat-shrink
conductors.note: Fourth conductor counted from the white stripe. Mark this half's machine −X end while the magnetic pair is mated in its attracting orientation. Cover this solder joint alone.

dress.sleeve: 4 individual heat-shrink sleeves over the solder joints
dress.description: Split the pogo end back 20 mm and slip one heat-shrink sleeve onto each conductor before soldering. Shrink each sleeve over its own joint. Keep the 4P ribbon bare through the bulkhead passage and ridge-wall clip.
dress.qualification: The contact half is shown outside the enclosure so all four tails can be seen. Bulkhead mounting and installed routing are separate assembly jobs.

materials.label: Cable
materials.detail: 350 mm BNTECHGO 22 AWG black 4P silicone ribbon

materials.label: Other end
materials.detail: 1 YYFKGCP 4-pin male pogo half · solder on 4 tails

materials.label: Slip-on pieces
materials.detail: 4 separate heat-shrink sleeves, one for each joint

materials.label: Tools
materials.detail: Stripper · SN-2549 JST crimper · soldering iron · heat gun · flush cutters · multimeter

steps.title: Cut & identify
steps.instruction: Cut one 350 mm 4P ribbon. Call the white-striped edge A1 / AM2, then count A2 / AM1, A3 / BM2 and A4 / BM1. Split the pogo end back 20 mm. With the magnetic pair mated in its attracting orientation, mark the corresponding machine −X end of each half.

steps.title: Crimp the JST end
steps.instruction: Splay and strip the four JST ends. Crimp four SXH-001T-P0.6 contacts, inspect the conductor and insulation barrels, then seat A1–A4 in XHP-4 cavities 1–4. Match cavity 1 to the native PCB AM2 label and the housing circuit-1 mark.

steps.title: Sleeve & solder the tails
steps.instruction: Slip one heat-shrink sleeve onto each conductor. At the loose front-top bench stage, feed the free pogo end through the empty bulkhead lead bore before soldering. Tin and solder A1/AM2, A2/AM1, A3/BM2 and A4/BM1 to male tails 1–4, read from machine +X toward the marked −X end. Shrink each sleeve over its own joint.

steps.title: Ring out & label
steps.instruction: With the harness disconnected, ring out each XHP-4 cavity to its matching male pogo pin and check all six pairs for isolation. Check contact retention and the four insulated joints. Label the housing J13 · PUMPS and stage the fixed half for bulkhead installation.

estimateBasis: 5 attended minutes per finished fixed J13 half at unit 25: 0.5 minute to cut and identify, 1.5 minutes for four JST crimps and housing insertion, 2 minutes for four solder joints and individual heat-shrink sleeves, and 1 minute to ring out and label. One practiced person completes the piece start to finish with the map, materials, hand tools and loose front-top ready; shared setup is amortized. Ten minutes is the upper planning allowance. This is a theoretical, unmeasured estimate. It excludes development and lookup, bulkhead mounting and cabinet routing, and the separately estimated cartridge-side cable.
